snippet.title: CORE | Understanding Suicidal Ideation | Mary Peltz | May 13, 2022
snippet.description:
C.O.R.E. Programs presents a Healing the Soul seminar: Understanding Suicidal Ideation with Mary Peltz facilitating. This free seminar is to educate and inform so you can walk away with information that will bring healing and restoration.

Video "Strangers saved me from suicide": https://youtu.be/LKT_h3fJBRY
Video "Schizoaffective disorder; Jonny Benjamin": https://youtu.be/PL8ZI3dwLHc
